translations.web: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.
translations.bsb: So you are to set up the tabernacle according to the pattern shown you on the mountain.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.
translations.asv: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which hath been showed thee in the mount.
